# Tenergy TN438 16-Bay AA/AAA Smart Charger

## Why I'd choose it

The <Entity value="Tenergy TN438" category="product" disambig="16-bay AA/AAA NiMH/NiCd battery charger"/> stands out because it offers:

- **16 independent charging channels:** Charge any number of AA and AAA batteries, without pairing them.
- **Two LCD screens:** Monitor individual batteries' charging and discharging status.
- **Refresh cycle:** Discharges and recharges batteries to help maintain their performance.
- **Safety protections:** Overcharging, overheating, short-circuit, over-current, and reverse-polarity protection.
- **Two power options:** Worldwide AC adapter and car adapter.
- **One-year warranty.**

It charges AA batteries at 500 mA and AAA batteries at 250 mA. A 2,000 mAh AA battery takes approximately 5.2 hours according to the manufacturer's specifications.

Sources: [Tenergy official specifications](https://power.tenergy.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-lcd-smart-battery-charger/) · [Dealectric's October 27 price verification](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn438-16-bay-nimh-charger)

## How the alternatives compare

| Charger | Price shown | Assessment |
|---|---:|---|
| **Tenergy TN438** | $57.99 | Best documented feature set |
| BEVIGOR 16-bay | $14.99 with coupon | Best budget alternative |
| CITYORK 16-bay | Not provided | Interesting alternative; 4.3/5 from 29 reviews |
| Generic 16-bay deal | $14.74 | Deal expired September 1 |

The BEVIGOR is worth considering if saving money is your priority. Its listing describes 16 independent bays for AA/AAA NiMH batteries, and the historical deal was $14.99 with a promotional code. However, the supplied pages don't establish that it offers the same LCD monitoring, refresh functionality, or documented safety features as the Tenergy.

Sources: [BEVIGOR deal](https://slickdeals.net/f/19880856-amazon-bevigor-16-bay-aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-14-99-w-code-deal) · [CITYORK Walmart listing](https://business.walmart.com/ip/CITYORK-16-Bay-LCD-Universal-Battery-Charger-for-1-2V-C-D-AA-AAA-Size-Ni-MH-Ni-CD-Household-Rechargeable-Battery-Fast-Charging/11807159043) · [DealNews expired offer](https://www.dealnews.com/16-Bay-AA-and-AAA-Ni-MH-Battery-Charger-for-15-free-shipping-w-Prime/21969819.html)

## Important caveat before buying

The TN438 is designed for **button-top rechargeable NiMH/NiCd batteries**. It does not support flat-top batteries. It also does not charge disposable alkaline batteries or 1.5V rechargeable lithium AA/AAA batteries.

## Final verdict

<badge color="success">My pick: Tenergy TN438</badge>

I'd spend the $57.99 on the Tenergy TN438 if you regularly manage a large collection of rechargeable AA and AAA batteries.

The BEVIGOR is the better bargain, but the Tenergy offers a more convincing feature set for long-term household use.

**Bottom line:** Best overall under $60: Tenergy TN438. Best budget alternative: BEVIGOR 16-bay.
